_readme: Expected intent for the six demo fixtures (email-simulator/src/email_simulator/fixtures and demo-scenarios/act*). These are NOT held-out: the prompt's examples were written after seeing msg-005 and msg-006 fail, so passing them shows the known failures are fixed, not how well the prompt generalises. 'threads' lists follow-up pairs whose Plane issue must still match: the follow-up's title or normalized subject has to score >= the matcher's threshold against the original issue's title.
